snippet.title: Official Teaser | Mr.Mag: The Dark Side Within
snippet.description:
The first official teaser for Mr. Mag: The Dark Side Within is here! 🎬✨
Step into a mysterious puzzle–adventure and follow Mr. Mag on his thrilling journey through The Dark Side Within.

Our official Steam page is now live too — check it out and don’t forget to hit that ❤️ Add to Wishlist!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3911680/MrMag_The_Dark_Side_Within/
